Accomplishment

1. Taiwanese Heritage Society of Houston (休士頓台灣人傳統基金會) – Founding member 1991, & Chairperson 2002, 2006

2. Taiwanese American Federal Credit Union理事長1993-2008; president & CEO 2010-2013

3. Taiwanese American Citizens League (全國台美公民協會) - Founding member 1989 & president 1993

4. Taiwanese Association of America - Houston Chapter - President 1979

5. Taiwanese American Citizens League (全國台美公民協會休士頓分會) - Founding member 1988 & President 1990, 1991

6. Asian American Coalition (亞美聯盟) – Founding member 1989 & Board Director 1989-1993

7. TACL Toastmaster Club – Houston Chapter (議會學社) - Founding member 1992 & president 1992

8. Taiwan 921 Earthquake Relief Fund in Houston (台灣921地震賬災基金) – Chairperson (主委) 1999

Hobby

Table Tennis, Swimming, Volleyball, Field & Track

Founding member and Chairperson of Taiwanese Heritage Society of Houston

President & CEO of Taiwanese American Federal Credit Union

Founding member of Asian American Coalition
